snippets.snippet: K ingsley is a Home Rule City within M etro Louisville incorporated in 193 9 . There are 176 homes . All are zoned single family only. There is a small section zoned for commercial properties. It contains a building with 2 businesses and 2 apartments and a gas/convenience store.
